We had a very relaxing stay in this hotel. The staff is very kind, welcoming and helpful. They surprised us a free upgrade. The room is big and modern with an incredible view of the ocean. It is one of the cleanest hotel I've been to. The breakfast was also good.

Eine wunderbare Destination: ruhig an der Klippe und in der Nähe des Walkerbay Nature Reserve. Das Frühstück sehr gut und die Staff immer freundlich! Meine Frau hatte Geburtstag und wir bekamen ein Upgrade in die Suite mit riesigem Whirlpool, den wir auch häufig nutzten.
★★★★★
Very nice, staff exceptionally helpful, professional and friendly. Breakfast very good and tasteful. We received a free upgrade on our room to a family suit because we stayed for 7 days. I highly recommend this hotel.

We had an absolutely amazing weekend away. The lovely hotel, the luxurious rooms, the friendly efficient staff and perfect location provided a perfect weekend away.

Frequently Asked Questions
Which room types are available at Sea Star Cliff? Guests can choose from Standard Rooms, a Superior Room, Luxury Suites, Family Suites, a Penthouse Room and a Penthouse Suite.
Do the rooms at Sea Star Cliff have ocean views? Yes. The room collection is designed around views of the Atlantic Ocean, Walker Bay and the surrounding Fynbos dunes. Outdoor spaces vary between terraces, balconies and rooftop terraces.
Which room has direct access to the pool deck? The Superior Room offers direct access to the pool deck as well as a private terrace and a freestanding bathtub.
Is breakfast available at the hotel? Yes. Breakfast is available to guests at Sea Star Cliff.
Are Wi-Fi and parking available? Yes. Sea Star Cliff provides complimentary Wi-Fi and free parking for hotel guests.
What are the check-in and check-out times? Check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Contact the hotel directly if your travel schedule requires special arrangements.

About Sea Star Cliff
Experiencing our passion for hospitality in every stay.
The finest independent luxury hotels in South Africa
Experiencing Our Passion for Hospitality in Every Stay
At Sea Star Cliff Boutique Hotel, hospitality is at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to offering guests an unforgettable stay, combining a pristine environment with attentive, high-quality service. Every detail is designed to ensure a warm and welcoming experience, marked by first-class amenities and personal care.
Perched above the coastline in De Kelders, the hotel boasts panoramic views over Walker Bay and the Fynbos Nature Reserve, creating a tranquil escape from the bustle of everyday life. Just a short walk from the ocean and close to South Africa’s best whale-watching locations, Sea Star Cliff offers spacious luxury suites, a sun deck, and an inviting outdoor pool.
